_comment: Talkative update manifest (spec section 7). Publish this as manifest.json in a public GitHub repo and set MANIFEST_URL (config.py or the manifest_url settings key) to its raw URL. Publishing an update = bump a version string, adjust size_mb/note, commit in the browser. Rollback = revert the commit. Versions are compared as plain strings: any difference from what the user has installed offers the update. 'note' is the one user-visible line in the (component-blind) dialog - never name the model in it. The grammar entry's hf_repo (sumitdas76/talkative-grammar) is also the source grammar_engine.download() fetches from for the on-demand Settings download, not just for updates.
